description: This Java class 'MockServerTestExecutionListener' extends Spring's AbstractTestExecutionListener to manage MockServerClient instances during test execution, including initialization, cleanup, and reflection-based field injection for mock server testing.

classes.name: MockServerTestExecutionListener
classes.description: A test execution listener for managing MockServerClient lifecycle and injecting mock server dependencies during Spring-based tests.

methods.name: prepareTestInstance
methods.description: Prepares the test instance by initializing MockServerClient and injecting it into fields annotated for mock server testing.

methods.name: setFieldValue
methods.description: Uses reflection to set the MockServerClient instance into the test class's fields.

methods.name: getMockServerFields
methods.description: Retrieves or computes the list of fields in the test class that are of type MockServerClient.

methods.name: findMockServerFields
methods.description: Recursively finds all fields of type MockServerClient in the class hierarchy.

methods.name: afterTestMethod
methods.description: Resets the MockServerClient after each test method if applicable.

methods.name: initMockServerClientIfRequired
methods.description: Initializes the MockServerClient if it hasn't been created, using environment properties, and registers a shutdown hook.

methods.name: isMockServerTest
methods.description: Checks if the current test class is annotated for MockServer testing.
